title: LLM Can be a Dangerous Persuader: Empirical Study of Persuasion Safety in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper presents a systematic investigation into the ethical boundaries of LLMs in the context of persuasion. It defines and benchmarks 'unethical' persuasion strategies (such as manipulation, deception, and exploitation) against 'ethically neutral' tasks, using established principles of ethical persuasion to evaluate model behavior.
